release_narrative: Wave I/I.5/I.6/I.7 vendor cloud-infrastructure hostname corpus integration. 4-wave autonomous extraction effort (12,212 main + 26 + 193 + 159 = 12,590 cumulative unique hostnames) integrated via 12+1 source admissions, ~12k raw_observation FK-chained provenance rows, and 12,239 identifier promotions across 51 canonical vendors. Migration 0024 extends the identifier_type CHECK enum 51 → 54 with three CP29 value classes (vendor_controlled_hostname, vendor_cloud_endpoint_url, vendor_controlled_hostname_deprecated). Marquee findings include hppki.honeywell.com promoted at 99 (firmware-cert ceiling via 2 Honeywell OTA signing certs + crt.sh + binary + bucket payload), 565 NXDOMAIN-verified deprecated hostnames, 108 §8.3 cross-source lifts. SAR-13 + SAR-13.5 codified as bible-amendment siblings.
